name: Rachika Nayar
label: NNA Tapes
lede: Rachika Nayar rescored an anime as Rachika S, spent four years on a debut of looped guitar, then put a trance kick drum under her second record and landed at No. 29 on Pitchfork's 2022 year-end list.

eras.title: Rachika S, scoring other people's pictures
eras.text: Nayar grew up in State College, Pennsylvania, with two Penn State professors for parents, and picked up guitar at ten. Before any album of her own she was in Brooklyn DIY and making music for film.

years.h: Brooklyn DIY first, including a queercore band called Mallrat
years.p: Paste's Best of What's Next profile lists Mallrat among the projects Nayar played in around the scene before her solo records.
years.xp: Paste's Best of What's Next profile lists Mallrat among the projects she worked on around the scene. She has also described making synth-pop with close friends in high school and drum and bass breakdowns in Ableton, so the guitar-and-laptop hybrid came from a wide pile of habits.

years.h: Rachika S takes Tekkonkinkreet and swaps in a soundtrack of her own
years.p: Her first release, on Brooklyn's Loveless Records, is nine instrumentals running from ambient to downtempo to techno, set against the 2006 anime.
years.xp: Loveless lists the tracklist as nine pieces, from the 1:23 opener "Intro // The Fire" to the 5:47 "Killing Machines" and the closer "A House By The Ocean". She was releasing under the name Rachika S at the time, and dropped the initial when her full-length albums arrived.

years.h: So Pretty, a feature film, gets her score
years.p: Wikipedia says she also starred in it; Magnetic Magazine lists film scoring among her work before the first album.

eras.title: A guitarist who stops sounding like one
eras.text: The debut took four years to finish and came out on NNA Tapes in March 2021. A companion EP of the loops behind it followed on RVNG Intl. five months later.

years.h: Four years of loops end up on NNA Tapes as Our Hands Against the Dusk
years.p: Processed guitar sits under strings, piano and a Korg M1 synth, with Ricky of YATTA's pitch-shifted vocal on one track.
years.xp:
Nayar told Magnetic Magazine she leaned on the Korg M1's vocal patches, which she called "angelic and very haunting". Ricky of YATTA sang on "Losing Too Is Still Ours", and she then pitch-shifted and time-stretched the vocal. Zeelie Brown played cello on the closer, "No Future".

Her touchstones, per the same interview, were Brian Eno's take on "Canon in D" and Hiroshi Yoshimura's Wet Land. Paste says the collaboration with Yatta Zoker on "Losing Too Is Still Ours" is what led to the album.

years.big: I like when electronic music feels organic.
years.h: Loops go in as guitar and come out as something else
years.p: Nayar to SLUG Magazine on her method: record loops, then run them through a prism of processing until one idea becomes many.
years.xp: She told SLUG that playing an instrument and producing on a computer each felt like "only singular facets" of her emotional life, so she uses both. The same interview ties her interest in transformation to queer experience and to rave culture's shared-but-solitary feeling.

years.h: fragments strips the album down to its loops
years.p: An EP of guitar etudes on RVNG Intl.'s Commend imprint, out five months after the album it accompanies.
years.xp: fragments is the stripped version of her process: the improvised guitar loops she normally buries under synths and strings. It was reissued in April 2023 with seven extra tracks, a story that picks up in the last era.

eras.title: Then the kick drum shows up
eras.text: Her second LP brought in club pulse and a singer. It became her biggest record so far and turned up on year-end lists.

yt: Official video: Heaven Come Crashing (feat. Maria BC)
years.h: Maria BC sings the title track, the first single
years.p: BrooklynVegan called it widescreen electro-pop; Maria BC returns on "Our Wretched Fate".
years.xp: Nayar told The FADER she found Maria BC through the song "Good Before". Adding vocals was new territory for her.

years.src: Album of The Year · Stereogum · The FADER · Wikipedia · BrooklynVegan
years.h: Pitchfork gives Heaven Come Crashing an 8.4 and Best New Music
years.p: It lands at No. 29 on the site's 2022 year-end list, after Stereogum made it Album of the Week.
years.xp:
Albumoftheyear.org lists Pitchfork's score as 84, which is 8.4 out of 10. Nayar wrote, produced and mixed the record herself, with extra mixing by Carlos Hernandez and mastering at Black Knoll Studio. Stereogum's James Rettig called the range "sinister, playful, traumatic, ecstatic" and put it at No. 35 on its own year-end list.

Unlike the debut, most of the songs were finished in six months to a year, she told The FADER: she felt clearer about her tools. The album draws on electronic film soundtracks and trance-club aesthetics, and her aim, she said, was for music to overwhelm the listener.

years.cap: Nayar at Pitchfork Music Festival, Union Park, Chicago
yt: Live at Union Park, Pitchfork Festival 2023
years.h: Cafe Oto in London, then Glasgow the next night
years.p: The release tour ran through summer festivals in Portugal, Czechia, Finland and Canada before the UK dates on September 12 and 13.
years.xp: BrooklynVegan's tour list also has Fremont Abbey in Seattle on July 29, Public Records in Brooklyn on October 1, Sleeping Village in Chicago on October 6 and 2220 in Los Angeles on October 8.

yt: Heaven Come Crashing (The Sight Below Remix)
years.h: The Sight Below remixes the title track
years.p: The ambient producer takes the song for a remix, one of the album's follow-ups.

eras.title: The back catalog gets its turn
eras.text: fragments got seven more pieces, the debut got a vinyl pressing, and Nayar made a record with Nina Keith.

years.p: The expanded vinyl adds seven pieces, including "hawthorn"; NNA Tapes reissues Our Hands Against the Dusk on vinyl the same day.
years.xp: The FADER said "hawthorn" is a slow build that dissipates without release. It also noted that Heaven Come Crashing made its own list of the 50 best albums of 2022.

yt: Disiniblud (Rachika Nayar & Nina Keith) live at Petit Bain
years.h: Then a duo record with Nina Keith, out on Smugglers Way
years.p: Disiniblud came out on July 18 on LP, CD, cassette and digital.
years.xp: Wikipedia lists Disiniblud as a collaborative album with Nina Keith, released July 18, 2025 on Smugglers Way in LP, CD, digital, streaming and cassette formats.
